claim_boundary: Finite proposal grammar, not novel theorems or exhaustive geometry. New explicit agent submissions are allowed outside this grammar.

methods.description: Seek an exact identity preserving signed cross terms; derive and check all premises before estimating.
methods.scope: symbolic identity sought, no numerical-to-global inference

methods.description: Try rational/synthetic adversaries before expensive arithmetic instances; distinguish abstract from source-admissible counterexamples.
methods.scope: finite adversarial controls, not a universal no-go unless a proof is supplied

methods.description: Design an enclosure with explicit domains, interval error and a proved uniform tail; never fit the target constant on the same sample.
methods.scope: finite enclosure plus a separate global remainder obligation

motifs.object: For B=[[a,b],[b,c]] and arithmetic S=[[s11,s12],[s12,s22]], map the exact joint range to (x,y,z)=(a-s11,c-s22,b-s12); seek x>=0,y>=0,xy>=z^2 without splitting correlated errors.
obligations: Derive the actual joint arithmetic range, including poles
Prove cone inclusion independently of target positivity
Control the whole test domain beyond one 2x2 compression
motifs.difference: Preserve the signed joint position relative to B, unlike three separate norm majorants; do not use the refuted rank-two indefiniteness sentence.
motifs.next_test: Derive a source-admissible joint enclosure and compare it with independent interval bounds on a fixed original window.
motifs.stop_condition: Stop if the enclosure is defined using the positivity it should establish, or only tests the desired answer.
motifs.scope: Original signed Weil normalization; complete source bridge remains unproved.

motifs.object: For an actual Toeplitz inverse coarse solution u_l, derive sign and summed Harnack control for corner increments; bound shat_l=s_l-Bx_l^T u_l with no assumed fine positivity.
obligations: Prove increment sign on the actual admissible class
Prove a summed ratio bound at all needed levels
Close new Schur complements and base cases independently
motifs.difference: Restrict to actual inverse increments; do not revive the failed solution-free norm bound or whole-core dilation estimate.
motifs.next_test: Write the discrete inverse recurrence and identify its first term whose sign is not yet sourced.
motifs.stop_condition: Stop if a maximum principle is assumed for a matrix not proved monotone.
motifs.scope: Original signed Weil normalization; complete source bridge remains unproved.

motifs.object: Construct a graded chain complex C with arithmetic correspondences and a scaling action; seek Str(exp(-tD^2)U_a) whose full regularized trace equals the signed prime/Gamma/pole functional.
obligations: Specify the actual chain complex and domains without zero data
Derive primitive arithmetic orbits
Prove the archimedean regularization and exact full trace
Identify an independent positive pairing on the relevant quotient
motifs.difference: Seek an explicit chain-level cancellation mechanism, not a numerical equality of Euler characteristics or a fixed finite E8 carrier.
motifs.next_test: Specify a minimal chain complex and test whether its correspondence trace includes the correct archimedean and prime-power factors.
motifs.stop_condition: Stop if the trace identity is inserted as an axiom or topology carries no arithmetic scaling.
motifs.scope: Original signed Weil normalization; complete source bridge remains unproved.

motifs.object: Construct inclusions A_n->A_(n+1) and conditional expectations E_n with E_n E_(n+1)=E_n, compatible arithmetic actions and uniform integrability for an unbounded limiting signed readout.
obligations: Actual growing operator domains
Compatible state and arithmetic action at every level
Tightness or compactness with growing dimension
Zero-independent signed Weil identification
motifs.difference: Keep growing-dimensional compatibility explicit instead of applying a fixed-Fintype compactness lemma or finite KMS identity globally.
motifs.next_test: Audit interlevel compatibility on two exact levels before proposing any limit.
motifs.stop_condition: Stop if embeddings, states or norm flow must be assigned separately at each level.
motifs.scope: Original signed Weil normalization; complete source bridge remains unproved.

motifs.object: Seek an arithmetic family of probability states rho_f whose relative-entropy Hessian at rho_0 equals the original signed Weil functional, with both prime and archimedean data in the state construction.
obligations: Source-defined normalized states independent of target positivity
Exact Hessian identity including signed terms
Domain and infinite-tail control
Full rational Gabor parameter coverage
motifs.difference: Entropy convexity alone is world-blind; the unproved mathematical task is the exact source-side Hessian identity, not the positivity of entropy.
motifs.next_test: Differentiate a fully specified finite model and display every unmatched signed term.
motifs.stop_condition: Stop if target positivity is required to define the probability state.
motifs.scope: Original signed Weil normalization; complete source bridge remains unproved.

motifs.object: For true minimizers of the original expanding-window form, derive lambda'(L)>=-a(L)lambda(L), with a locally integrable through any hypothetical first zero, retaining prime-entry jumps.
obligations: Independent positive starting window
Regularity of actual spectral bottom
Actual minimizer equations and arithmetic correlations
Integrability through zero and prime-entry jumps
Complete test-class coverage
motifs.difference: Use actual minimizers, not the refuted estimate over every high-frequency form-core vector; no division by an unknown positive spectral gap.
motifs.next_test: Derive the signed derivative and identify whether a minimizer equation cancels the known high-frequency obstruction.
motifs.stop_condition: Stop if a(L) contains 1/lambda(L) or a nonintegrable singularity at the supposed first zero.

motifs.object: Decompose the exact rational Gabor prime-side form into an arithmetic block and a signed remainder, with one source-defined bound valid over all rational width and frequency regimes.
obligations: Exact block identity including Gamma and poles
Uniform infinite arithmetic remainder
Small-width and large-frequency boundary regimes
No sampling-to-uniform inference
motifs.difference: Add a genuinely proved arithmetic remainder instead of reusing heat normalization as an RH-equivalent restatement.
motifs.next_test: Identify and isolate the remainder term not controlled by current ARCH interpolation.
motifs.stop_condition: Stop if the bound is fitted from the target form or uses critical-line zero data.

motifs.object: Construct a canonical arithmetic event algebra from composition labels, then derive a signed transfer identity by factorization of its incidence or Mobius operators rather than prescribing log-prime energies.
obligations: Canonical multiplicative state labels
Functorial composition and multiplicities
Independent archimedean component
Exact signed transfer identity
motifs.difference: Composition may explain primitive primes but does not itself prove RH; the new target is an explicit signed arithmetic identity, not another partition function.
motifs.next_test: Give exact composition and incidence maps and calculate the first nontrivial signed transfer terms.
motifs.stop_condition: Stop if the primitive events or required prime weights are inserted instead of derived.
